A '''strummer''' was a musician who played a [[xantha]]. Strummers were included in many [[Band/Legends|music bands]] seen in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] across the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]], particularily during the wars between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], an [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] strummer played with [[Load Lifters|''The Load Lifters'']] and a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] with the ''[[South Sector Boppers]]''.
